The design is fixed and all visible tests pass (`TEST PASSED`).

Root cause: `in_ready` combinationally depended on `out_ready` (violating the spec's requirement that it depend only on registered state), and `skid_valid` was never cleared after the skid word moved into the output register, leaving the skid buffer permanently "full" after first use. Fixed `in_ready` to be `!skid_valid` only, and added the missing `skid_valid <= 1'b0` clear when the skid word is popped into the output register.
